scope: First promotion batch from the country-by-country and first-level subnational audit.
method: Official institutional source and Wikidata identity checks, Chromium/HTTP retrieval, dated-event/schedule surfaces and source conditions. Link-only readiness is distinct from media playback and HLS/EPG readiness.

added_as_official_links.evidence: Official House proceedings portal linked to the House website and the upper-house service. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed the current Diet term, a dated concurrent committee-broadcast schedule and searchable recordings. This is one portal covering chamber and committee events, not a separate permanent feed for each committee.
added_as_official_links.rights_posture: The official broadcast copyright page says website links are generally free, while text, photographs and video remain subject to copyright. No broad independent live-media playback permission was established.
remaining: Active-sitting player/media validation
Source-specific live reuse and caption review
Event/room identity and machine-readable EPG mapping

added_as_official_links.evidence: Official Parliament Mediathek. The institutional sitting guide documents live Nationalrat, Bundesrat and Bundesversammlung coverage. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed dated sittings of both chambers. Keep one shared portal record until distinct recurring chamber or room player identities are validated.
added_as_official_links.rights_posture: Parliament terms allow specified political reporting, political education and private non-commercial uses. Audiovisual material must carry the Parlamentsdirektion copyright marking; attribution and third-party rights also apply. Individual ORF/live-media ownership and full-stream reuse were not established, so this record remains an official viewing link.
remaining: Active-sitting player/media validation

added_as_official_links.evidence: The official Assembly committee-broadcast introduction returned HTTP 200 in Chromium and links this current committee directory. held_candidates.decision: The official broadcast guide documents plenary and open-committee coverage and permits distribution of the Althingi channel. Chromium received a 403 challenge. Keep researching until a current normal-browser player and supported stream route can be checked; do not restore a historical watchlist HLS URL solely because it existed.
The official regional assembly web-TV page was identified, but Chromium received HTTP 403 Access Denied. Retain the source for a current player, event/schedule and reuse-terms check before promotion.
